failure.body:
On 202205 `testQosSaiQSharedWatermark` and `testQosSaiPgSharedWatermark` are failing with the following error:
```
        elif "wm_pg_shared_lossy" in pgProfile:
>           if dutConfig['dstDutAsic'] == "pac":
E           KeyError: 'dstDutAsic'
```

This is a regression from https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/10654 merging to 202205.
The issue being that the PR which adds `dstDutAsic` to `dutConfig` hasn't merged to 202205 yet:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/10655

Once this PR merges I'd expect this issue to go away.
